title: ～方（かた） — “how to ～”
summary: Attached to the stem of a verb (the ます-form without ます), it makes a noun meaning “the way of doing ～”: 読み方, 作り方, 行き方.

patterns.gloss: verb ます-stem + 方 (読み方)
する-verbs: noun + の + し方

body.p: Take the ます-stem and add 方 (食べます → 食べ方). Since it is a noun, the object links with の, not を (漢字の読み方).
It often pairs with 教えてください or 知っていますか when asking how to do something.
〜方 is a noun naming the method itself. どうやって is an adverb asking about the method.

examples.ja: この漢字（かんじ）の読（よ）み方（かた）を教（おし）えてください。
examples.romaji: Kono kanji no yomikata o oshiete kudasai.
examples.tr: Please teach me how to read this kanji.

examples.ja: この料理（りょうり）の作（つく）り方（かた）を知（し）っていますか。
examples.romaji: Kono ryōri no tsukurikata o shitte imasu ka.
examples.tr: Do you know how to make this dish?

examples.ja: 駅（えき）までの行（い）き方（かた）を教（おし）えてください。
examples.romaji: Eki made no ikikata o oshiete kudasai.
examples.tr: Please tell me how to get to the station.

pitfalls: Do not attach it to the dictionary form (not 読む方). Use the ます-stem.
As it is a noun, the object takes の (not 漢字を読み方).
